key.description: Unique key of the completeness configuration entry

activated.description: Whether this completeness configuration entry is activated

mission.description: Mission the completeness configuration applies to (e.g. S1, S2, S3)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit the completeness configuration applies to

service_type.description: Service type the completeness configuration applies to (e.g. DD, LTA)

service_id.description: Identifier of the service the completeness configuration applies to

start_date.description: Start date of validity for this completeness configuration

end_date.description: End date of validity for this completeness configuration
